adjusted_model.note: model with '-' and '/' replaced by ' ' (regex substitution, not a simple concat), e.g. model='MC-SB30JW049' -> 'MC SB30JW049', model='NT 38/1' -> 'NT 38 1'. When model has neither, adjusted_model == model.

keywords.note: Equals sku_type_complete on ~99.9% of live rows (brand + ' ' + model). keyword_typo is a separate free-text column, '' when there are no known misspellings; not prefixed into keywords. Unknown power/capacity/function/vacuum_type are stored as '' (empty string), not NULL; wired is 'Cordless' on nearly every row regardless of real cord type (legacy).
